<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Simdots One-Pager</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
@page{size:A4;margin:0}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{background:#ddd}
body{width:210mm;height:297mm;margin:0 auto;padding:13mm 15mm 11mm;background:#fff;color:#111;font-family:'Inter Tight',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:10.5pt;line-height:1.38;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5.5mm;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}
header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:8.5pt;color:#555}
header b{color:#111;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Inter Tight',sans-serif}
h1{font-size:27pt;line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:700}
h1 span{color:#06843f}
.lead{font-size:12pt;color:#333;margin-top:2.5mm}
h2{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:8pt;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#06843f;margin-bottom:1.3mm}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5.5mm 8mm}
section{border-top:1px solid #d7dbd3;padding-top:2.2mm}
ol{padding-left:4.5mm}
.nums{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6mm}
.nums b{display:block;font-size:19pt;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.1}
.nums span{font-size:9pt;color:#444;display:block;margin-top:.8mm}
footer{margin-top:auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:8pt;color:#666;border-top:1px solid #d7dbd3;padding-top:2mm}

/* ===== Simdots brand theme ===== */
header{background:#000;color:#fff;margin:-13mm -15mm 0;padding:7mm 15mm;align-items:center}
header .brand{height:6.2mm;width:auto;display:block}
header span{color:#bdbdbd;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
h1{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.045em;font-size:29pt}
h1 span{color:#9a9a9a}
h2{color:#000;font-weight:500} h2:before{content:"✦";margin-right:2mm}
section{border-top:1px solid #111}
.nums b{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.045em;font-size:22pt}
footer{border-top:1px solid #111;color:#555}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header><img class="brand" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Simdots"><span>Raising €100k</span></header>
<div>
  <h1>When the world changes, <span>a company must know what to do.</span></h1>
  <p class="lead">Simdots simulates a shock on a business and returns the next moves: prices, banks, stock, alternative suppliers and purchasing.</p>
</div>
<div class="two">
  <section><h2>Problem</h2><p>Tariffs, wars and headlines move overnight, and smaller companies react by instinct. In our interviews a tannery decides "by nose", an optics company "by feel", and a construction company pays consultants for the answer. Knowing the loss is not enough. They need the next move.</p></section>
  <section><h2>Solution</h2><ol><li>Map the business in 10 minutes.</li><li>A tariff, a war or a statement from a president hits.</li><li>Thousands of simulations combine macro data, trends and global logistics to show the loss.</li><li>The plan ranks each move by the margin it protects.</li></ol></section>
</div>
<section><h2>Backtests and progress</h2>
  <div class="nums">
    <div><b>−1.2 pts</b><span>average gap from reality on the Hormuz, Ukraine and Crimea benchmarks (internal)</span></div>
    <div><b>2</b><span>companies paid about €1k each for analysis from our engine, through our consultancy</span></div>
    <div><b>1k</b><span>users on our data tools, datastripes.com and howtocsv.com. The app is live</span></div>
  </div>
</section>
<div class="two">
  <section><h2>Market</h2><p>$2.4B global supply chain risk software market, growing ~12% a year. SAM of €560M: 311k EU manufacturers with 10–249 employees at €1,800/year. Three-year target: 1,000 customers, €1.8M.</p></section>
  <section><h2>Business model</h2><p>Pro at €1,800 a year, custom plans for consultants and larger firms. Simulations run on the customer's computer, so serving a new customer costs us almost nothing.</p></section>
  <section><h2>Landscape</h2><p>Resilinc, Everstream and Interos sell enterprise contracts that take months to deploy. Kpler, Panjiva and Sayari sell trade data. Consultants work per project. Simdots is self-serve, and supplier data stays on the device.</p></section>
  <section><h2>Team</h2><p><b>Vincenzo Manto</b>, CEO: engineer, 10 years building business software for Italian listed companies.<br><b>Riccardo Dal Cero</b>, Chief Economist: macroeconomist, formerly at the European Central Bank; supply chain and policy consultant.</p></section>
</div>
<section><h2>What we are looking for</h2><p>€100k to ship the next moves engine, convert our 1k users into first subscribers and open the consultant channel.</p></section>
<footer><span>info@simdots.com</span><span>app.simdots.com</span><span>TAM: SkyQuest 2025 · SAM: Eurostat 2024</span></footer>
</body>
</html>
